notes.title: Unique Weapons Update
notes.content:
The time has finally come to make Unique weapons more unique. I've also added a few new bows and a potion.
Another requested feature is allowing other characters to purchase starting abilities that Lannon has access to. They are pricier, but you get the primary and secondary when purchased. Only one character may have each of these abilities at a time, so there can be no duplication.
I've also increased the frequency of Ability points slightly to help with these purchases.

And, of course, bug fixes.

Enjoy!

3/24/25
+1.7.6.0
+ Added 3 new Unique Weapons
+ Buffed some unique weapons
+ Each Unique weapon now has a totally unique attribute
+ Added 2 new bows
+ Added a new super rare potion type
+ Starting abilites can now be purchased by other characters, but only one time each by the party
+ Ability points now come every 6 levels instead of 7
+ Changed max damage from 9999 to 999999, because some of you are ridiculous and I'm here for it
+ Fixed bug that generated too many copies of some cloaks
+ Fixed a bug that kept generating unique items at stores after they had already been bought or generated
+ Fixed Rycard leaping onto invalid tiles in rare circumstances
+ Fixed a rare screentouch bug when selecting items in a stash
+ Fixed a bug with Mana Fire reduction math
+ Fixed a bug where the inventory was not expanding properly on rare occasions, causing an error
+ Fixed a bug where Lannon would gain skill points after training
+ Fixed a rare pathfinding bug late game in Undermoor, using Seeking Lights
+ Fixed inventory size reducing to 120 (minimum is 240)

notes.title: Some new QoL options and a few minor adjustments
notes.content:
With an influx of iOS players, I'm seeing new styles of play and also encountering new bugs (albeit minor ones).
You should now be able to listen to other music sources external to the game. I wasn't aware that I was muting outside sources until now.

2/2/24
1.4.3.0
+ Audio from other sources is no longer muted
+ Added rotation options more mobile devices
+ Moon Gems now show up in inventory mode even if no outline UI is being used
+ Additional information on Initiative rolls added to Info section
+ Fixed modified spell range with traits and enchantments not always working
+ Forging now has a minimum ore cost of 1
+ Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245046/4e48e600bcf566faab52f848bfba1730aaa5a4b5.png

It's been a year since Caves of Lore launched. A lot has changed in that time. Players like you have been a big part of additions and improvements to the game. Below is a small summary of changes since launch.

Controller Support, Achievements and Stat Respeccing.
New Starting Character Options, including Female hero option.
New Lore, New Secrets and Quest Notes.
New Abilities, Traits, and Spells.
Adjustable Casting Levels, Key Rebinding and Difficulty Settings.
New Books and New Conversation Keywords.
New Items, Unique Weapons, Equipment Sets and Enchantments
Balance Changes, and many other QoL updates.

Today I am adding a Female Hero option, along with new Spells, Abilities and some other minor changes.

I've worked on Caves of Lore pretty much every day since launch. It's been a wild ride as a solo dev with no previous experience, but this community has been more than I imagined it could be. I couldn't have done it without you, and I'll continue to do so for as long as I can.

notes.title: Stoneskin update. Other minor stuff.
notes.content: A few small changes, but more notable, Stoneskin now applies to Armor, not Defense. This was always my intent, and I must have forgotten that along the way. Now you can shield your wizards properly!
